metadata.title: Exclusive | Robinhood Revamps $695 Platinum Card After Customers Take Issue With Perks - WSJ

content.text:
Robinhood HOOD is learning just how discerning ultra-luxe credit cardholders can be.
The company known for its trading app is retooling its platinum card after customers complained about the perks when it was announced back in March. For a card that charges a $695 annual fee, many pointed out that some of the perks weren’t as generous as they seemed.
